subject.title: feat(plugins): order Featured catalog by recency

question: Should OpenClaw expose ClawHub promotion recency as the `featuredAt` Gateway catalog field and make it the ordering authority for Featured entries?
rationale: The patch is mechanically additive, but it turns an external catalog’s curation timestamp into a cross-client presentation contract; maintainers must decide whether that is the intended durable product behavior.

options.title: Sponsor the recency contract
options.body: Confirm the timestamp semantics and unit with the ClawHub producer, retain the absent-field fallback, and require direct Control UI proof before merge.

options.title: Retain existing catalog ordering
options.body: Decline the new field and continue using the existing `order` and name fallback as the only Featured ordering inputs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the recency contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the timestamp semantics and unit with the ClawHub producer, retain the absent-field fallback, and require direct Control UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contact spanning the proposed OpenClaw consumer and linked ClawHub producer work.
